name: RC-B10-0371/2025 – § 2 – Am 3
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the detention of EU citizens in the occupied areas of Cyprus
part_text: 2.Condemns the occupying regime’s disregard for every notion of justice and its attempt at abduction and hostage-taking to escalate intimidation at a crucial political juncture for the prospective resumption of negotiations, and to target and influence those who attempt to visit their ancestral properties or appeal to the‘Immovable Property Commission’ in the occupied areas;
